title: Ascendastock launch
author: Ascendastock
selftext:
Hey everyone,

This is my first post on reddit and wanted to announce the launch of my new website for stocks called Ascendastock. If one chose to invest their money in what my algorithm suggests they could make serious profit as it has on average a 70% success rate based on early testing.

**Here is how I built the logic:** Instead of just showing static charts, I wanted it to act like a robotic financial planner. I integrated the Gemini AI API and connected it to live S&P 500 data.

The core feature is a "Deep Mind" scanner. When a user inputs their budget and time horizon, the AI doesn't just guess—it parses the live data and generates three probability-weighted models:

* **Balanced:** Safe, blue-chip heavy.
* **Aggressive:** Tech/growth focused.
* **Moonshot:** High-risk, high-reward allocations.



**My ask for this community:** I just launched the MVP, and because I’ve been staring at this code for months, I am completely blind to its flaws.

If any of you have a background in fintech, trading, or just SaaS in general, I would love some brutal honesty on the UI and the onboarding flow.

* Does $34.99/month make sense for the value provided?
* What features would you need to see to actually use this daily?

To find Ascendastock simply search [ascendastock.com](http://ascendastock.com)

Thanks in advance for the feedback. Happy to answer any questions about the tech stack or how I set up the AI agent loop!
